title: dfo-docs roadmap index
description: The published roadmap.json names the roadmap tracks and says where to fetch each one. It carries no entries. Each track is a separate document validated by roadmap-track.schema.json and owned by the team that owns that part of the product, so a track is edited, reviewed, and published without touching the others. Fetch this file first, render the tabs from it in array order, and load a track's own document when its tab is opened.

schema_version.description: The compatibility signal for this index, versioned independently of the manifest and of the track documents. Adding an optional field keeps it. Removing a field, renaming one, or changing what a field means bumps it. Adding or removing a track leaves it alone, since tracks are data here rather than a fixed enum.

generated_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp of this build, second precision, with a trailing Z.

generator_commit.description: The commit of the dfo-docs generator that produced this file. Omitted, not null, when git was unavailable at build time.

tracks.description: Every roadmap track, in the order the tabs render, with the first as the default tab. A track stays listed here while its document holds no entries, so an empty tab renders an empty state rather than vanishing. This index carries no counts: fetch a track's document to learn what is in it, since a count declared here could disagree with the file it describes.

track.description: One tab, and a pointer to the document behind it.

id.description: Stable and opaque. Matches the `track` field of the document at `file`, which the build checks.

label.description: The tab's display text, in sentence case. Change it freely, since `id` is what anything stored keys on.

description.description: Optional intro copy for this tab, where a track needs to say what it covers before its entries make sense.

file.description: The track document's path relative to the branch root, such as `roadmap/data.json`. Resolve it the way `corpus_path` is resolved in the manifest.
